entries.content: Patient presented with worry about work performance, occasional racing thoughts before deadlines. Mild generalized anxiety noted. Recommended breathing exercises and follow-up in 6 weeks. Patient declined medication at this time.

Had a difficult session yesterday. Patient was frustrated when I explained we needed to look more carefully at some new symptoms before moving forward with the treatment plan. Took an extra 20 minutes and they left seeming annoyed. Part of the job I suppose, but these conversations are never easy when someone just wants to get on with things.
